quickAnswer: The Wetherspoons breakfast wrap costs a typical {price}, contains {calories} kcal, and comes with fried egg, crispy bacon, Lincolnshire sausage and a hash brown inside a soft, gently toasted tortilla. taste:
The Breakfast Wrap combines rich, meaty fillings with crisp potato inside a soft tortilla. Bacon provides a crisp texture, while the Lincolnshire sausage brings a savoury flavour alongside the fried egg. The golden hash brown adds another crunchy element, so the texture is not simply soft throughout. Gentle toasting gives the tortilla a different feel from the fillings without losing its softness.

It is served warm, with the breakfast components gathered into a portable format. That makes it suited to someone who prefers their egg, bacon, sausage and potato together rather than eating each separately. The contrast between the soft outer wrap and crunchy filling is its main appeal.
